scope: Small offline scientific replay, no scientific-admission promotion

A.candidate_1: NOAA GML AGGI published 2025 CH4/N2O global mean values and Table1 CH4 equation
A.target: Reproduce published 2025 methane effective radiative forcing, compare rounded NOAA table
A.uncertainty: Reported abundance uncertainty propagated analytically; formula uncertainty separately reported, no temperature conversion
A.legacy_replay: PR143 ideal-gas parcel and PR144 synthetic control-volume ledger, unchanged

B.candidate_1: NOAA CPC current RONI ERSSTv6 1991-2020 base; never splice ONI/v5
B.candidate_2: BoM Australian area-average monthly/seasonal rainfall, subject to product-specific licence
B.phase_definition: single three-month RONI >=0.5 warm, <=-0.5 cold, otherwise neutral; not CPC five-consecutive-season event classification
B.weather_outcome: rainfall below the 1961-1990 season median, only if rainfall is admitted
B.primary_comparison: warm vs cold conditional dry-season proportion; Wilson interval and paired-year moving-block bootstrap
B.sensitivity: JJA index to SON rainfall; seasons separately; 1961-1990 versus 1991-2020; lag1 autocorrelation; 3/5-year blocks; no selection by best result
B.if_rainfall_blocked: No weather association estimate. Report only RONI historical seasonal counts and JJA-to-SON index persistence with uncertainty; label statistical weather link DATA_NOT_READY. Synthetic counterexample is separate.

C.candidate_1: Reuse public HRS 410033 2020 source shard at fixed PR129 987cc1dc7170204e5eab3d1750590ba463ea9d08; January window fixed before QC
C.real_gate: Source licence, quality, daily interval/UTC and ML versus ML/day must be resolved before any volume balance. Cooma is an audit example, never a Nile substitute.
C.synthetic: Three linked control volumes with one shared internal flow; integrate all rates to m3 per day; propagate independent external term errors and cancel shared internal terms
C.missing_terms: Unknown lateral flux or storage returns blocked residual attribution, never zero-fill or call residual evaporation
